summary: Verified all 4 security fixes (SEC-001..SEC-004) and full regression on TâcheHéros backend. 25/25 pytest cases pass (9.2s). SEC-001 seed guard: POST /api/dev/seed-demo returns 403 without X-Admin-Key (and with a wrong key) and 200 with the correct JWT_SECRET; auto-seeded demo family (papa@demo.fr) still exists. SEC-002 penalties: child->403, parent-without-pin->403, parent-with-pin succeeds; Family A run only penalizes A's child (Family B untouched); second run in same day is idempotent (points unchanged). SEC-003 photos: same-family fetch works via both Authorization header and ?token= query; cross-family returns 404; no-token 401; bad token 401; path traversal '../foo', 'foo/../bar', '..%2Fx' -> 404; leading '/' -> 404. SEC-004 push: unauthenticated 401/403, bad token 401/403, authenticated call ignores bogus user_id in body and updates ONLY the caller's push_token (verified via /auth/me for both users). Regression: papa/lea demo logins, PIN 1234 verify, GET /tasks, /family (>=4 members), /challenges, /events, /badges, non-photo task auto-approve+award (+15 pts), photo task pending -> parent vote approve awards points (+30 pts), second-parent join via family_id all pass.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py auth on /photos correctly rejects '..','\\', leading '/' before decoding token; ordering is fine.
SetPushToken still has required user_id field in the Pydantic model, but backend correctly ignores it and derives user from JWT — schema could later drop user_id to eliminate confusion, non-blocking.

Penalty idempotency relies on unique (family_id, user_id, task_id, day) tuple; no DB unique index enforces it, only a query-then-check pattern — acceptable for single-node cron but could race in a scale-out deployment. Consider adding a compound unique index in a future iteration.
server.py is ~1080 lines — split into routers (auth, tasks, penalties, photos, rewards, challenges) for maintainability. Non-blocking.
seed_data_creation: Startup auto-seed provides papa@demo.fr / lea@demo.fr / hugo@demo.fr / emma@demo.fr (Famille Dupont). New test data uses TEST_ prefix + uuid-derived throwaway emails; each test creates isolated families so no cleanup of demo data required.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 SEC fixes verified. Photo test relies on Emergent object storage; test_photo_task_vote_approve_awards_points and TestPhotoScoping.photo_ctx call pytest.skip() if storage returns 500. Admin key for /api/dev/seed-demo == JWT_SECRET literal in /app/backend/.env. Penalties are idempotent via new 'day' field on penalty docs. Push endpoint requires Authorization header; body user_id is ignored (still required by SetPushToken schema).
